attributes.title: 2027 AANP Health Policy Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANP Health Policy Conference runs February 7 to 9, 2027, at the Grand Hyatt Washington in Washington, D.C., with early packet pickup on the evening of February 6. It is aimed at nurse practitioners who want to understand federal health policy, from first-time advocates to experienced policy hands.

The program combines sessions, a keynote and an exhibit hall, and the last day is set aside for congressional visits on Capitol Hill. AANP lists most sessions at one contact hour and the congressional visits block at 2.5 contact hours; a total has not been published. Registration costs $700 for AANP members, $290 for student members and $950 for non-members.
